cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Routes answer 403 {error:'forbidden'} whatever the UI shows
402 trial_over, no_credits or agent_cap: nothing is charged
Chat: 402 chat_allowance (month's messages used) or chat_credits (under the 5-credit hold); 429 slow_down is a notice, no dialog
Media with too few credits: inline 'Needs N credits; you have M.'
Chat switch: 409 trial, 429 slow_down. Partner code: 400 bad_partner_code / self_referral, 409 already_attributed / already_paid
Founder plan route (400): bad_credits, bad_seats, bad_chat, bad_deal, below_floor, deal_needs_agency; unknown email 404. Top-ups: bad_pack, bad_paid, bad_date, bad_ref, 409 topup_needs_paid_plan
Brand add: 429 slow_down after 10 an hour or 30 a day; 409 busy while the brand list is locked; the default brand cannot be archived (400)

cards.title: Plans and allowances
items: Starter 299 SAR: 300 credits and 250 chat messages a month, 1 seat
Pro 499 SAR: 700 credits and 650 chat messages a month, 3 seats
Business 999 SAR: 1,500 credits and 1,300 chat messages a month, 7 seats
Trial: 50 credits, 30 chat messages for the whole trial, 3 seats, 3 days
Agency: by contract, at least 999 SAR and 1,500 credits; without a valid deal it gets 1,500 credits and 7 seats
Top-up packs: 100, 300 or 1,000 credits at 1 SAR each before VAT, valid 90 days, spent after the plan credits, kept at renewal
Chat past the allowance: off by default; on, each message bills its cost, at most 5 credits. First-month offer: 15% off
Brands are unlimited on every plan; setting up an added brand from its URL costs 9 credits, the first brand is free

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Owner only: billing, chat switch, partner code, account delete, MCP token, partner and payout bank, phone and email prefs, roles
Admin and owner: manage brands, edit brand fields, invite and remove plain members
Every role: switch brand, view team, change own password and name
Founder impersonating: owner view, but delete, password, invites, roles, MCP token, OAuth approval and partner bank are blocked
Founder console only: plan, credits, chat messages, top-up packs, seat override and the Agency deal

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28
Chat replies that the agents are paused; no credits were used. A chat whose messages for the month are used still raises the chat dialog first
Ask Noor and reports: 'Content generation is paused for now.' (/api/generate 503 model_paused, before trial and credit checks)
Image and video renders still run with a fixed prompt, and the /start confirm calls no model, so only they can raise the credits dialog
